study.question: Does reweighting centered target-match contrasts to equal energy per active temporal block improve full-population click AUC over the globally scaled incumbent and a reversed-gain replacement at fixed learned capacity, support and total coefficient norm?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g0-r0017-available_norm reaches0.6658605169646938 AUC versus available_raw0.665271526636978, whereas joint_norm0.6657390847414351 is below joint_raw0.6658060840537754. Thus scale and support interact; the latest declared source usage does not establish normalization as universally beneficial. The incumbent fifth channel remains a scalar multiple of the first centered match coefficient across the entire example. Its squared energy in each block therefore remains proportional to that block's raw match energy. This structural limitation is verified in the pinned source, not a measured causal explanation. Mechanism hypothesis: after preserving the first raw match channel and the three order summaries, a fifth channel balancing energy across active blocks supplies complementary contrasts from weaker-energy blocks to the task adapters. It should exceed both global normalization and the same positive gains reversed among active blocks. This is an unverified implementation-specific hypothesis, not a claim that match energy measures reliability or that balancing establishes a new architecture family.

study.proposed_difference: Let a_b be the incumbent within-block centered match-affinity vector and e_b=sum(a_b^2). On active blocks e_b>1e-10 set g_b=1/sqrt(e_b); inactive gains are1. Candidate raw coefficients are g_b*a_b, so active blocks have equal energy before the final normalization. Reversed control assigns the same gain multiset to active blocks in reverse active-block order, preserving support without moving events or values. Global control uses incumbent a*sqrt(P/sum(a^2))*availability exactly. Candidate and reversed coefficients are each rescaled to squared norm P=sum(centered_position^2), using the same basic availability P>1e-10 and sum(a^2)>1e-10. No labels, elapsed times, raw IDs, outside statistics, sample identity or RNG enter the new coefficients. Reweighting preserves zero padding and within-block centering; generally adds a direction different from the first match summary when block energies differ. Retain the same five-channel contraction and adapter dimensions in all cells, and build all alternatives in all cells. Originality is unverified.
predictions: Primary prospective ordering: block_energy_local click AUC exceeds both block_energy_global and block_energy_reversed at the frozen full-data recipe. AUC differences <=0.0002 are operationally unresolved without paired repetition; this is a practical threshold, not a significance test.

Local/global coefficients coincide up to FP32 tolerance with one active block or identical active-block energies, and all cells return zero fifth coefficients for empty or unavailable matches. Local energy is equal across active blocks; reversed control retains active support and the pre-normalization gain multiset.

Expected unchanged32129765 total parameters,31793216 embedding and336549 dense. Measured wall, allocated GPU time, peak memory, inference throughput and p50/p95 latency must be reported. Equal coefficient norm does not imply equal value-summary norm or equal measured compute.

Exploratory localization: effects may be larger in history_gt64 than empty/short histories because more blocks can differ. Use only host-authorized history-length slices with their sample/positive/negative counts; a slice pattern is not a confirmatory mechanism test. Report all four task AUC/logloss and auxiliary mean separately, including degradations versus DIN.
falsifiers: If local fails to exceed the global and reversed controls by a consequential margin on validation, useful energy-alignment complementarity is unsupported for this implementation. A single failure does not refute all forms of block-aware matching.
If local and reversed perform similarly while both exceed global, attribute no benefit to aligned energy balancing; extra coefficient direction or altered optimization remains plausible.

If a proposed win disappears under authorized paired seeds, or is explained by parameter mismatch or material measured cost without a quality-cost benefit, reject the claimed advantage. Single-seed results remain provisional.

If same-seed global bridge does not reproduce incumbent predictions/AUC within host numerical tolerance, first investigate input/source/initialization or execution differences; do not treat it as independent evidence or select based on that discrepancy.
Any padding leakage, nonfinite coefficients/gradients, wrong task outputs, changed gradient ownership, unavailable-input dependence or breached hard cost cap invalidates comparison regardless of AUC.
alternative_explanations: Latest norm/support interaction could be one-seed optimizer sensitivity, conditioning or a data-dependent gate effect; no repeated support exists.
Global normalization may usefully preserve relative evidence intensity; local balancing may amplify weak or coincidental matches and worsen click or auxiliary outcomes.

Reweighting can change learned value-summary norms and covariances despite identical coefficient norm. Controls hold capacity and support fixed but do not fully match representation distributions or training trajectories.

Reversing gains among active blocks changes the correlation of gains with ordinal position and energy simultaneously; a positive contrast supports this alignment operationally, not a unique latent mechanism.

Prior negative trajectories matter: compressed task selectors g0-r0006-compressed_task underperformed both source bests; separated-field details g0-r0010-field_detail_task underperformed g0-r0009-match_detail_task; joint_ordered g0-r0016-joint_ordered did not beat duplicate_match. Those outcomes argue against simply adding detail and do not prove this new replacement.

Task-specific curvature g0-r0014-curvature_task outperformed shared_curvature g0-r0015-shared_curvature, motivating fixed task routing here; this cross-round single-seed contrast does not replace future paired attribution.

Auxiliary label semantics are category/brand-window outcomes under official_offline visibility, and auxiliary performance is below DIN despite improved click AUC. No production causal validity or universal multi-task gain follows.
